description: This is a test file for utility functions in tenantClient.js, testing functions like normalizeTenantId, fetchSessionTenants, selectTenant, and setActiveTenant.

methods.name: normalizeTenantId
methods.description: Normalizes various tenant identifier object shapes or string input into a string id.
